items.label_en: 1. Drive the King into the Corner
items.explanation_en: Use the bishops to control both color complexes, coordinate with the king, and force the enemy king into the corner with zugzwang.
Use the bishop to control a7, advance the king to cut off the defender, and push the pawn at the right moment.
Coordinate the h-pawn, king, and bishop to cover every escape square around the cornered king.
Use king and bishop to control e7, advance the d-pawn, promote with check, and mate with the queen.
The bishop protects the pawn as it promotes; then the queen and king form a mating net.

items.label_en: 5. Wrong Bishop, King Too Far Away
items.explanation_en: Although the bishop is the wrong color for the corner, the defending king is too far away to reach it before the h-pawn promotes.

categories.label: 象双兵对象
categories.label_en: Bishop and Two Pawns vs. Bishop

items.explanation_en: Use the bishop to drive the king away, bring the white king around to support the central pawns, and promote one of them.
The defending bishop holds the f6-g7 diagonal, exploiting the limited routes available to the edge pawns.
The light-squared bishop controls a8, while the dark-squared bishop cannot stop the pawn from promoting. Kf3 cuts off the defender's route back.

items.label_en: 2. Hold the Draw by Avoiding an Exchange
items.explanation_en: Keep the same-colored bishop safe from exchange and guard the f6-g7 diagonal to hold the draw.

items.label_en: 3. Tempt the Bishop into an Exchange
items.explanation_en: Use Be8 as a waiting move to lure the black bishop to h5, then capture it and promote the pawn.
